verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is itself a private AI assistant with built-in AI agents. First-party sources describe agents that work out of the box, custom agent skills, agent flows, and web scraping and search, and the assistant can automatically transcribe and summarize meetings into action items. Most of the agent evidence is page titles or marketing lines rather than detailed docs on how tasks get delegated, and community comments praise general usability but not agent task execution. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of agent task delegation and execution, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agents completing delegated tasks.
